nodes.name: Calculate Days to Expire
nodes.notes:
Calculates expiry in human-readable format.

Formats:
- 'Expires today/tomorrow'
- 'X days'
- '1 week 2 days'
- '2 months 1 week'
- 'Expired X days ago'

Status: Critical/Warning/Good/Expired

nodes.name: Analyze Health Rating
nodes.notes:
Analyzes health rating based on ingredients and nutrition.

Scoring (0-100):
- Harmful ingredients: -10 to -40 points
- High sugar/sodium/fat: -15 points each
- Trans fat: -30 points
- High fiber/protein: +5 points each

Ratings:
- 80-100: Healthy
- 60-79: Moderate
- 40-59: Not Healthy
- 0-39: Harmful

nodes.name: Store in Google Sheets
nodes.notes:
Appends product data to Google Sheets.

Setup:
1. Create Google Sheet with columns:
   Product Name, Expiry Date, Days to Expire, Expiry Status, MRP, Weight, Health Rating, Health Score, Concerns, Ingredients, Energy (kcal), Protein (g), Carbs (g), Sugar (g), Fat (g), Saturated Fat (g), Trans Fat (g), Sodium (mg), Fiber (g), Date Added

2. Replace YOUR_SPREADSHEET_ID with actual ID
3. Configure Google Sheets OAuth2 credentials
4. Add conditional formatting for expiry status and health rating

nodes.name: Check Expiry Alert
nodes.notes:
Checks if product expires within 7 days.

Conditions:
- Days to expire <= 7
- Not already expired

True = Send WhatsApp alert
False = Skip notification

parameters.name: text

nodes.name: Send WhatsApp Alert
nodes.notes:
Sends WhatsApp notification via Evolution API.

Setup:
1. Deploy Evolution API (self-hosted, free)
2. Replace YOUR_EVOLUTION_API_URL with actual URL
3. Replace YOUR_INSTANCE with instance name
4. Replace YOUR_PHONE_NUMBER with format: 91XXXXXXXXXX (country code + number)

Evolution API Docs: https://doc.evolution-api.com/

parameters.text:
Analyze this product packaging image and extract the following information for this consumable item:

  - Product Name (full name including brand)
  - Brand (manufacturer/brand name separately, e.g., "Britannia", "Parle", "Amul")
  - Category (main product type: Snacks, Beverages, Dairy, Bakery, Confectionery, Frozen Foods, Ready to Eat, Condiments, etc.)
  - Sub-category (specific type: Biscuits, Chips, Cookies, Chocolates, Juice, Milk, Cheese, Bread, etc.)
  - Expiry Date (format as YYYY-MM-DD, look for "Best Before", "Exp Date", "Use By")
  - MRP (Maximum Retail Price with currency symbol)
  - Weight/Quantity (with unit like g, kg, ml, L)
  - Ingredients (complete comma-separated list)
  - Nutritional Information (key nutrients per 100g/100ml: Energy/Calories, Protein, Carbohydrates, Total Sugar, Total Fat, Saturated Fat, Trans Fat, Sodium, Fiber)

  IMPORTANT: Return ONLY valid JSON with no markdown formatting or code blocks.

  JSON format:
  {
    "productName": "string",
    "brand": "string",
    "category": "string",
    "subCategory": "string",
    "expiryDate": "YYYY-MM-DD",
    "mrp": "string with currency",
    "weight": "string with unit",
    "ingredients": "comma-separated string",
    "nutrition": {
      "energyKcal": number,
      "proteinG": number,
      "carbsG": number,
      "sugarG": number,
      "fatG": number,
      "saturatedFatG": number,
      "transFatG": number,
      "sodiumMg": number,
      "fiberG": number
    }
  }
